text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I gave it everything I had, so I 
have no regrets.
choice_data_list: I'm relieved you're not down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... However, there are still points I 
need to reflect on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Getting overwhelmed by her drive and 
losing the duel just shows how much I 
still have to learn...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that I lost on spirit alone makes 
it so much more frustrating!
choice_data_list:
Let's use everything you've worked for 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the power's bubbling up inside me 
again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Trainer, your cheers are sort of 
mysterious in a way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It gives me a kind of power that's 
different from pure muscle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to show you the power you 
gave me this time around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Please train me again. I'm begging you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Yes! I feel all fired up now!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't keep on losing like this. Next 
time, I really want to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... You feel the same way, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Will you join forces with me once 
again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: In one shooot! Ahaha, thank you so much!!
